in_hebrew.name: Jago
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jago הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the old Cornish language, Jago is derived from the name Iago, which means 'young warrior' or 'yew tree'. This name has been popular in Cornwall for centuries and is now gaining popularity worldwide.
